intro: 50 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions, 75 min, pass 75%, USD 150, online and unproctored, two attempts within 14 days. No hands-on lab any more. Domains: YAML Configuration 22%, Pipeline Development 18%, CI/CD Fundamentals 18%, Troubleshooting & Optimization 14%, Container & Package Management 12%, Security Integration 8%, Runner Configuration 8%.

flowchart LR
